status: post-outcome diagnostic frozen after collective-personal lane-B result and before opening the model-ladder scores
role: separates marginal individual state from spatially resolved personal 3D shape in strictly future prediction

parent_result.known_before_freeze: personal conditional profiles beat other-individual conditional profiles in all three lane-B panels, but total self-conditional versus other-marginal gain is positive only in Hypsignathus

target_and_history_rules.same_target_support: all model scores use exactly the same target fixes supported by both self-conditional and other-conditional histories

models.G0_group_marginal: equal-individual mean of other-individual equal-session marginal P(z)
models.I0_self_marginal: equal-session mean of focal-individual marginal P(z)
models.G1_group_conditional: equal-individual mean of other-individual equal-session P(z|cell)

aggregation: equal target session within biological individual, then equal biological individual

uncertainty.method: cluster bootstrap biological individuals with replacement

claim_boundary: This diagnostic was motivated by known lane-B results and is not independent confirmation.
A positive personal_conditional_advantage alone means the focal map is less wrong than other maps; it does not imply positive absolute predictive value over a marginal baseline.
A positive self_spatial_increment is the required evidence that spatially resolved personal 3D shape adds forward predictive information beyond the focal animal's own marginal vertical state.
No target set, lag, grid, support rule, weighting, contrast or bootstrap criterion may change after output.
